responsibility: Provides the main rs6000 target configuration for PowerPC Darwin/Mac OS X. It switches the backend to the Darwin ABI and Mach-O object format, sets Darwin-specific PIC, frame, register, preprocessor, assembler, and linker behavior, installs Darwin hooks for builtins, section anchors, exception/runtime quirks, and Objective-C support, and defines the ABI and code-generation rules that distinguish PowerPC Darwin from AIX and ELF targets.
same_name_distinction: This is the Darwin target-configuration header: it sets Mach-O/Darwin ABI macros, specs, register usage, and target hooks for PowerPC Darwin. Unlike darwin.md, it does not define RTL insn patterns, and unlike darwin.opt, it does not declare the Darwin-specific command-line options.
